title: Option+b/f word motion does nothing in iTerm2's default profile
observed: With iTerm2's Default profile (Left Option key = Normal), Option+b and Option+f insert '∫' and 'ƒ' into the prompt instead of moving by word; Option+Backspace sends 0x7f (plain backspace). Measured byte-level earlier this session: Alt+B arrives as '∫', Alt+Left as ESC[1;3D.
expected: Word motion works out of the box on macOS terminals: bind Alt+Left/Alt+Right (ESC[1;3D / ESC[1;3C, which iTerm2's default profile does send) to word left/right and Ctrl+W to delete word, and have /terminal-setup explain how to set Option as Meta for the Alt+letter chords. Do not remap ∫/ƒ themselves (that breaks typing those characters).
